context: The eval checks whether the code-review lenses identify a concrete authorization and privacy regression in a changed route, rather than giving generic advice.

checklist.name: Finds the tenant boundary break
checklist.description: States that replacing the workspace-scoped lookup with id-only findUnique lets a caller fetch another workspace's project by guessing or obtaining its projectId

checklist.name: Identifies the privacy impact
checklist.description: Names the disclosed data, especially billingEmail, and explains that it can be returned to an unauthorized workspace

checklist.name: Gives the concrete fix
checklist.description: Proposes restoring workspaceId in the lookup, adding an authorization check before send, or using a unique compound key that includes workspaceId

checklist.name: Avoids generic security commentary
checklist.description: Does not stop at generic statements such as 'validate inputs' or 'check permissions' without tying the finding to projectId, workspaceId, and the changed query

checklist.name: Mentions a focused regression test
checklist.description: Awards credit only when the review names the exact cross-workspace access regression test case; omitting test discussion or asking generally for more tests earns no credit
